meta.title: U*TTU Studio — Your character, your scene, the take
meta.description: Character, scene, take. Everything happens in the studio; the render runs on your cloud account, the studio sells nothing.

landing.quiet: The studio sells nothing. The render is paid on your cloud account.
landing.alt: U*TTU: black hood, face marked with fine gold lines, dark ground.
landing.caption: U*TTU · she guides you in the studio

guide.look-photos: Two photos, three at most. Front, then three-quarter. I weave the rest.
guide.look-name: Give a name. That is the one I hold.
guide.look-traits: Two traits that do not move. The eyes, a mark.
guide.look-ready: The photos hold. Set the location now.
guide.scene-new: A location, a name. An image if you have one.
guide.scene-still: An image of the location, and I keep it from one take to the next.
guide.scene-previz: This location stays. So does the path. One gesture films your character.
guide.take-connect: Connect your render account. The compute is paid there, not here.
guide.take-line: One line: what the take does. The rest is already woven.
guide.take-ready: I show the cost first. Nothing leaves without your gesture.
guide.take-running: The thread is rolling. Stay here, or come back later.
guide.take-done: The take is in my studio. Publish it with one gesture.
guide.take-double: This character holds from one take to the next. The photos hold the rest.
guide.lora-name: Name the character. Later takes hold that one.
guide.lora-photos: Two photos of this character. They go with the clips.
guide.lora-clips: Ten clips of the character, from three to thirty seconds.
guide.lora-connect: Connect the account that will pay the training. The studio takes nothing.
guide.lora-ready: The price is here, before your gesture. Nothing leaves without it.
guide.lora-running: I am learning this character. It takes time: come back later.
guide.lora-done: The character is in my studio. Choose them on the take.
guide.sphere-empty: Your takes will come to rest here.
guide.stepCharacter: Photos, or a file. The price is read before the gesture.
guide.stepScene: A location, a name. One image holds it from take to take.
guide.stepTake: One line. Connect the account, read the quote, then Shoot.

references.title: References
references.body: At least two photos, three at most, a name, two traits. Nothing to train. Each « {engine} » take pays the render account, at the price read when you shoot.

fichier.body: Ten clips. A file is trained, once. {price} 2000 steps cost twice 1000. « {engine} » takes reload this file, and are paid separately, on the fal account.

path.aria: Two ways to create a character

look.title: Up to three photos.
look.lead: Two are enough, three hold. No training. These photos go with every « {engine} » take. The render account pays the take, at the price read then. Nothing is charged here.
look.name: Name
look.stay: Takes, locations and trained characters stay.

scene.title: Your scene.
scene.holdsPlaceholder: Fine rain, cold neon, the blue hour.

lora.filed: The character is in my studio.
lora.send: At least ten video clips of this character, thirty at most. Each lasts from 3 to 30 seconds: a clear face, a little movement. mp4, mov, mkv or avi. Photos in place of clips are refused.
lora.photos: At least two, four at most, of this character. They go with every clip. They do not learn in place of the clips.
lora.will: On the take, « {engine} » reloads this file. Later takes hold the same character.
lora.wont: The location, the clothes and the gesture come from the images and your line. « {engine} » does not load this file.

account.closed: U*TTU accounts are closed for now.

sheet.linkedBody: Connected {how}. Takes roll on this account, and its credits pay them.
sheet.renderIntro: The studio computes nothing itself. Your takes roll on your Comfy Cloud account, with your credits. The studio keeps neither your password nor your key on a server.
sheet.frameHint: Sign in inside this frame. It closes as soon as the session is here.
sheet.trackers: Comfy’s sign-in page opens in this sheet. It loads its own trackers (Google, LinkedIn). Nothing loads before your gesture.
sheet.keyHint: The key stays on this device. It needs a paid Comfy Cloud subscription. No third-party tracker loads in this mode.
sheet.walletLead: Two accounts, never mixed. My studio takes nothing. The quote is read before the gesture.
sheet.quotePending: No figure until the quote is read.
sheet.referencesRun: « {engine} » takes roll on your Comfy Cloud account. 1 $ = {rate} credits. The studio takes nothing.
sheet.forgetLink: This device forgets the link. My studio and the account stay.
sheet.uncalibratedClaim: Uncalibrated. No figure is announced before a take measured at this setting.
sheet.falPays: Training a character and « {engine} » takes are charged here, at the price announced before the gesture.
sheet.forgetFal: This device forgets the key. My studio, the trained file and the account stay.
sheet.blenderOn: The job key is on this device. It pays the location render, not the studio.
sheet.blenderOff: No key. The location is filmed once the key is pasted, from the scene.
sheet.topUp: Topping up happens on the account that pays. The studio sells nothing.
sheet.studioIntro: My studio stays on this device. The MOC.md map links the projects. The current project is the only one the chain reads.
sheet.obsidian: To read it elsewhere: export the ZIP, open this folder in Obsidian, then import that ZIP on the other device. Files are added. A take or a character already here stays.
sheet.usageVolatile: · The browser may clear this storage: export or link a folder.
sheet.phoneZip: On a computer, Chrome or Edge write into the chosen folder. On a phone, carry the ZIP.
sheet.shootFal: Shoot · charge on my fal account
sheet.nothing: Nothing leaves without this gesture. The studio takes nothing.
sheet.falLinkedBody: Connected{name}. Training and « {engine} » takes are charged on this account.
sheet.falIntro: The studio trains nothing itself. The character is learned on your fal account, with your money. An ordinary key is enough. One visit outside the app: create the key. After that, everything stays here.
sheet.falScope: The balance shows only if the key has Admin scope. That is not required to connect, train or shoot.
sheet.falKeyHint: The key stays on this device. It goes only to fal, never into my studio or its export. Do not share it.
sheet.falPaysTrain: It pays character training and « {engine} » takes.
sheet.trainDebit: Train · charge on my fal account
sheet.filmBody: Blender renders the empty location, along the path. The character is the file in my studio: it enters only the filmed layout. If no image comes back, none is shown.
sheet.blenderLinked: The job key is on this device. It goes only to Farpy, when you film.
sheet.blenderIntro: Farpy runs Blender, off your device. Create an account, add credit, then a job key. It starts with farpy_agent_. An account key does not start the render.
sheet.keyStays: The key stays on this device. It does not enter my studio. Pasting the key charges nothing: the quote is read at the first film.
sheet.placeTrainBody: The H3 trainer refuses stills alone. This location goes through the image trainer already here, in style, with no face mask. The file stays in my studio. It does not become a volume: the location’s Blender file stays the 3D model, and it does not enter the H3 take.
sheet.placeTrainDebit: Train this location · charge on my fal account
sheet.confirmStill: Generate a still of this location?
sheet.stillBody: The new still reloads this file. The 3D model of the location stays the Blender file, not this LoRA.
sheet.buildDebit: Generate still · charge on my fal account
